bases.name: Guelph Paramedic Base 0
bases.address: 355 Elmira Road North, Unit 134, Guelph, ON
bases.notes: Melran Mall. Remains current operational roster site; replacement planned at 218 Speedvale, procurement Q1 2027 in 2026 budget. Coordinates are the verified active municipal GIS address point for 355 Elmira Road North 134 (OBJECTID 30152); not a surveyed entrance.

bases.name: Guelph Paramedic Base 3
bases.notes: Administrative offices and staffed operational paramedic base; shared Fire Station 6 site. Coordinates are the verified active municipal GIS address point for 160 Clair Road West (OBJECTID 43335); not a surveyed entrance.

bases.name: Guelph Paramedic Base 12
bases.notes: Current roster lists three paramedic crews 24/7. Coordinates are the verified active municipal GIS address point for 34 Gordon Street (OBJECTID 4186); not a surveyed entrance. Current physical deployment requires confirmation: a September 14, 2026 report attributed to the paramedic chief describes temporary relocation from 34 Gordon Street after September 11; the undated official roster still lists this address. This is not a permanent-closure determination.

operationalReview.decision: Withhold playable selection until the operating location is confirmed; preserve the historical identity and source point.

bases.name: New Speedvale paramedic station replacing Elmira Road
bases.shortName: New Speedvale paramedic station replacing Elmira Road
bases.address: 218 Speedvale Avenue, Guelph, ON (direction omitted by project sources)
bases.notes: Design/commissioning consultant contract awarded August 13, 2025. Current confirmed budget assigns 2026 design and 2027 construction funding, with construction procurement deferred to Q1 2027. No operational opening date or construction start verified. Direction requires confirmation: both 218 Speedvale East and West exist in official GIS. City records show acquisition of 218 Speedvale West, making West the likely site, but the project/tender sources omit direction; coordinates withheld.
